newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 69 OF MARCH 5, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 69 OF MARCH 5, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMON POSITION (EC) No 9/97 adopted by the Council on 20 December 1996 with a view to adopting Council Directive 97/.../EC amending Directive 91/439/EEC on driving licences

COMMON POSITION (EC) No 10/97 adopted by the Council on 20 December 1996 with a view to adopting European Parliament and Council Directive 97/.../EC of ... concerning the placing of biocidal products on the market

COMMON POSITION (EC) No 8/97 adopted by the Council on 16 December 1996 with a view to adopting European Parliament and Council Directive 97/.../EC of ... amending Directive 93/6 EEC on the capital adequacy of investment firms and credit institutions and Directive 93/22/EEC on investment services in the securities field.
